packet.title: Conformance sweeps (implementation, repeatable)
packet.summary: Repeatable conformance sweeps over the in-scope XSLT 4.0 test sets, each claiming its files in docs/LOG.md.

body.p: After . As 2.19, over in-scope XSLT sets (misc-regex-syntax 987 and misc-error 500 first: they measure the regex engine and error codes cheaply). Each sweep claims its files in docs/LOG.md. Sweep 1 done 2026-10-19 (): XT40 in scope 7,585 to 7,737 of 8,728 by this sweep (86.9 % to 88.6 %; 7,879, 90.3 %, with 4.16's packages), errors 7 to 3; number 57.5 to 97.4 %. Open: value-of (empty text nodes and cdata, Proposed), the call's static context at run time (Proposed), memory of many small trees (json-to-xml-013, array-022), xsl:function cache (function-1031), call-template-ext, host collations. Sweep 2 done 2026-10-19 (): XT40 in scope 7,879 to 7,986 of 8,728 (90.3 % to 91.5 %), errors 3 to 1; value-of 53.3 to 93.3 % (every core set ≥ 80 %); zero-length text nodes and CDATA requests (tree.h), sized arena trees, xsl:function cache, the static context of a call at run time, declarations local to a package, XTDE0160, XTSE1650, XTSE1660. Open: json-to-xml-013 (memory, Proposed: streaming constructor content), XTDE3052 when an abstract variable is read, call-template-ext, host collations. Sweep 3 done 2026-10-18 (): content streams into constructors (receiving and delivering tasks, content LETs, building into the receiver's tree), 56-byte arena nodes; json-to-xml-013 passes, XT40 in scope 7,987 of 8,728, errors 1 to 0. Open: XTDE3052 when an abstract variable is read (globals computed on first read, Proposed), call-template-ext, host collations.
